payload.title: Add error and health visibility to the git-native backend
payload.body: Failure modes are silent today: malformed log events are skipped with no warning, and a claim that appends locally but fails to push is dropped on the next force-fetch with no clear error to the user. Surface skipped/corrupt events and a failed claims-push as explicit errors, and have tasks doctor report staleClaims, log size, and last-projection status.
